summary: This change upgrades the contract-first-assurance schema to 1.5.2 and substantially hardens verify_run.py: it requires full commit IDs and a matching finalHead, validates gate names and accepted-disposition policies, converts accepted-exception evidence from a flat path list into category-mapped, hash-verified evidence, and rejects symlinked or escaping frozen inputs. The verifier logic and its new tests are internally consistent, and JSON/YAML artifacts parse correctly. The one defect found is a key-name drift between the host adapter's snake_case disposition policy and the camelCase keys the new verifier enforces, which can cause a valid assurance manifest to be rejected.

findings.title: Disposition policy key names drift from the verifier's required camelCase schema
findings.trigger: An assurance agent builds run-manifest.json's adapter.acceptedDispositions by copying the host adapter's mutation_policy.accepted_dispositions (allowed_raw_statuses / required_evidence) as the host-adapter contract describes, without translating the snake_case keys to the camelCase keys the verifier now requires.
findings.consequence: verify_run.py's disposition_policy_errors reads policy.get("allowedRawStatuses") and policy.get("requiredEvidence") (verify_run.py:62,70); a manifest carrying the adapter's allowed_raw_statuses / required_evidence yields "adapter accepted disposition EXPECTED_MUTATION_LIVENESS has invalid allowedRawStatuses" and "... has invalid requiredEvidence", so a legitimate assurance run fails verification and the delivery gate is reported as not reproducible/passing.
findings.evidence: vformation.yaml:38-46 defines accepted_dispositions with allowed_raw_statuses and required_evidence, while verify_run.py:62,70 and reproducible-runs.md:23-26,116 require allowedRawStatuses and requiredEvidence under adapter.acceptedDispositions; no documented snake_case-to-camelCase mapping exists between the adapter and the manifest schema.
findings.suggestedFix: Align the key names: either rename the adapter fields to allowedRawStatuses/requiredEvidence (and acceptedDispositions) to match the verifier, or make disposition_policy_errors accept both snake_case and camelCase spellings, and document the accepted_dispositions -> adapter.acceptedDispositions mapping in host-adapter.md.
